candidates.statement: ALTER TABLE Plant ALTER COLUMN price TYPE DECIMAL(10,2) USING ROUND(price::numeric, 2)
candidates.engine_range: postgresql: all versions (most type changes rewrite)

size.source: pg_class.reltuples and pg_total_relation_size, exported from staging on 2026-11-10 (row counts only)

candidates.effect: ALTER COLUMN TYPE rewrites Plant under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock: reads and writes wait for the whole rewrite
candidates.rewrite: Add a new column of the new type, backfill it in batches, dual-write, switch reads, then drop the old column in a later release

candidates.statement: ALTER TABLE Plant ALTER COLUMN price TYPE DECIMAL(10,2) USING ROUND(price::numeric, 2)

size.source: pg_class.reltuples and pg_total_relation_size, exported from staging on 2026-11-10 (row counts only)

candidates.effect: DOUBLE PRECISION to DECIMAL(10,2) narrows the column: values that don't fit are rounded, truncated or rejected
candidates.rewrite: Check every value fits first (SELECT count(*) WHERE col <> col::newtype), convert explicitly with USING, and keep the old column until verified

facts.why: DOUBLE PRECISION values are rounded to 2 decimal place(s), and any value of 1e8 or more fails the conversion and aborts the migration

candidates.statement: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "StockAlert_plantId_key" ON "StockAlert"("plantId")
candidates.effect: CREATE INDEX takes a SHARE lock on StockAlert: inserts, updates and deletes wait until the index is built
candidates.rewrite: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY in its own non-transactional migration (Alembic: with op.get_context().autocommit_block(), postgresql_concurrently=True)
